q.description: scalar or 1-dimensional array specifying the desired quantiles. ``q`` should contain integer or floating point values between ``0`` and ``100``.

axis.description: optional axis or tuple of axes along which to compute the quantile

out.description: not implemented by JAX; will error if not None

overwrite_input.description: not implemented by JAX; will error if not False

method.description: specify the interpolation method to use. Options are one of ``["linear", "lower", "higher", "midpoint", "nearest"]``. default is ``linear``.
constraints: method must be one of linear, lower, higher, midpoint, nearest

keepdims.description: if True, then the returned array will have the same number of dimensions as the input. Default is False.

weights.description: keyword-only. optional array of weights for each element in `a`. Values with higher weights contribute more to the percentile calculation. The weights array must be broadcastable to the shape of `a` along the specified axis. Currently, weighted percentiles are only supported when `method="inverted_cdf"`.
constraints: weights must be one of inverted_cdf

output.description: An array containing the specified percentiles along the specified axes.
